_purpose: OPERATOR REFERENCE ONLY. Not design DNA. The owl template is the sole source of layout, component and section design for the generated site.

platform.theme: Divi child theme — 'CGI Digital Divi Child v.1.0.0'

strengths: Genuinely strong, specific copy — the no-subcontracting promise, the warranty numbers and the owner's name are all stated plainly rather than hedged.
Real project photography, including drone shots and crew-at-work images, rather than stock.
Three location pages with real addresses, hours and phone numbers — good local-SEO instinct.
A public project map with photographed, address-tagged completed jobs — unusual and persuasive.
Financing is explained in detail instead of reduced to a badge.
weaknesses: No dedicated per-service pages. Roofing is split only into Residential / Commercial / Gutters, so metal roofing and storm damage — both substantial offerings — have no page to rank.

Third-party widget load is heavy: UserWay accessibility, GTranslate, a CGI Communications survey pop-up, ProjectMapIt, Google Maps static tiles and multiple GreenSky iframes all load on the home page.
The GreenSky financing block dumps several hundred words of lender legal text straight onto the home page, dominating a full screen of scroll.
The residential page buries eight paragraphs of metal-panel spec copy (Master Rib, PBR, IR, ValuRib) mid-page, where it reads as a supplier catalogue rather than a homeowner's decision aid.
Home page hero is a muted autoplay video with a thin text overlay; there is no visible phone CTA or form above the fold.
Accent colour is inconsistent — the brand red (#CF152D) competes with two untouched Divi defaults (#2EA3F2 link blue, #0038F0).
The /commercial page names the owner as 'Joe'; every other source says Miguel. A live factual error.
No structured data, no llms.txt, no service-level FAQ markup.
No testimonials carry a location or a source platform, weakening them.
load_notes: Full-page render is 7,748px tall at 1280px wide. A large share of that height is lender legal disclosure and an embedded map widget rather than content the visitor came for.
carry_forward: Keep every fact: no subcontracting, 10-year workmanship + 15-year craftsman warranty, Miguel personally on estimates, three offices, showroom, $250 referral, free leaf guards.
Promote metal roofing and storm damage to their own service pages.
Keep financing as a short band with a link out — not an inline lender iframe.
Use the real project photos; drop the Divi blues and run a single red accent.
